item.title: Russell Brand's Addiction, Leonardo DiCaprio's Sad Public Persona, and Greta Thunberg Breaks Character, with Dr. Drew | Ep. 1444 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Megyn Kelly is joined by Dr. Drew Pinsky, host of “Ask Dr. Drew," to discuss the UK system trying to punish Russell Brand for saying that he's innocent, how the former addict can defend himself over decades-old accusations, how others who are in recovery are worried over their actions now being scrutinized from long ago, how Greta Thunberg is now literally laughing at the climate activism that she once led when she was a child, how the myth of Greta Thunberg got people like Michael Knowles cancelled, Thunberg now getting real about wanting to overthrow capitalism and the fraud of climate activism, how Americans keep getting warned to prepare for something but it's unclear what we should actually be preparing for, Marco Rubio knocking down reports of a “dirty bomb” threat to America, the busload of young women that showed up at Leonardo DiCaprio’s 52nd birthday party, his sad public persona of non-stop bachelor life and constantly dating 25-year-olds, the truth about Matthew Perry and how his fame interacted so poorly with addiction, his lack of accountability, the tragic Presley Gerber story and what it says about addiction, the alarming new details about Kroy Biermann and Kim Zolciak’s 15-year-old son KJ, why he is being tried in adult court despite being a minor, the disturbing new allegations of his past crimes against a young girl as a 12-year-old, the traumatic moment that occurred with a pop star when he...didn't try anything with her when she was 22, and more.
